dedupe_keys.name: benchmarking af de regulerede drikke og spildevandsselskaber

description: Benchmarking af de regulerede drikke- og spildevandsselskaber is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Konkurrence- og Forbrugerstyrelsen. In the benchmarking, we compare the cost-effectiveness of the individual water companies with each other. The benchmark calculates the companies' individual efficiency score, which tells whether the company compared to the other companies is efficient or not. Coverage: Konkurrence- og Forbrugerstyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "Benchmarking of the regulated drinking and waste water companies" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Konkurrence- og Forbrugerstyrelsen. Its keywords include Energi- og vandforsyning, Energi, Miljø, Regulering af vandforsyningen, miljø, effektivitet. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-10-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
